source: wago.tools DB2 wowf 1.60.1.70790 with hotfixes, plus the Forever client hotfix cache (build 70862, 5,223 records)

talents.name: Unbreakable Will
ranks: Reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 30%.

talents.name: Wand Specialization
ranks: Increases your damage with Wands by 25%.

talents.name: Silent Resolve
ranks: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 30% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by 15%.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Fortitude
ranks: Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 15%.
Increases the effect of your Power Word: Fortitude and Prayer of Fortitude spells by 30%.

talents.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
ranks: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by 20%.

talents.name: Martyrdom
ranks: Gives you a 0% chance to gain Focused Casting for 6 sec after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by 20%.

talents.name: Inner Focus
ranks: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by 100% and increases its critical effect chance by 25% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

talents.name: Meditation
ranks: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Improved Inner Fire
ranks: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by 45% and increases its total charges by 12.

talents.name: Mental Agility
ranks: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Mana Burn
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by 1 sec.

talents.name: Mental Strength
ranks: Increases your total Intellect by 15%.

talents.name: Divine Spirit
ranks: Holy power infuses the target, increasing their Spirit by 17 for 1 hr.

talents.name: Force of Will
ranks: Increases your spell damage by 1% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 1%.
Increases your spell damage by 2% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 2%.
Increases your spell damage by 3% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 3%.
Increases your spell damage by 4% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 4%.
Increases your spell damage by 5% and the critical strike chance of your offensive spells by 5%.

talents.name: Power Infusion
ranks: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by 20% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Twilight Focus
ranks: Gives your spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Improved Renew
ranks: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by 5%.

talents.name: Holy Specialization
ranks: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by 1%.

talents.name: Spell Warding
ranks: Reduces all spell damage taken by 10%.

talents.name: Divine Fury
ranks: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by 0.5 sec.

talents.name: Holy Nova
ranks: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing 25 to 29 Holy damage to all enemy targets within 10 yards and healing all party members within 10 yards for 47 to 55. These effects cause no threat.

talents.name: Blessed Recovery
ranks: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than 30% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal 8% of the damage taken over 6 sec. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

talents.name: Inspiration
ranks: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by 0% for 15 sec.

talents.name: Holy Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by 10%.

talents.name: Improved Healing
ranks: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by 15%.

talents.name: Searing Light
ranks: Increases your Holy damage done by 10%, and gives a 10% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

talents.name: Spirit of Redemption
ranks: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for 15 sec. The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects. While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost. When the effect ends, the priest dies.

talents.name: Spiritual Guidance
ranks: Increases your spell healing by up to 25% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to 8% of your total Spirit.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing
ranks: Increases the amount healed by your spells by 2%.

talents.name: Lightwell
ranks: Creates a holy Lightwell near the priest. Members of your raid or party can click the Lightwell to restore 800 health over 10 sec. Being attacked cancels the effect. Lightwell lasts for 3 min or 5 charges.

talents.name: Spirit Tap
ranks: Gives you a 0% chance to increase your Spirit by 100% for 15 sec after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, 50% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

talents.name: Blackout
ranks: Gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Gives your Shadow damage spells a 4% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Gives your Shadow damage spells a 6% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Gives your Shadow damage spells a 8% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.
Gives your Shadow damage spells a 10% chance to stun the target for 3 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Affinity
ranks: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by 8%.

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
ranks: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by 6 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Focus
ranks: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by 5%.

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by 4 sec.

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast
ranks: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by 2.5 sec.

talents.name: Mind Flay
ranks: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Fade
ranks: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by 6 sec.

talents.name: Shadow Reach
ranks: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by 20%.

talents.name: Shadow Weaving
ranks: Your Shadow damage spells have a 100% chance to increase the Shadow damage the target takes from you by 2% for 15 sec, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.name: Silence
ranks: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for 5 sec and interrupting their spellcasts for 3 sec.

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace
ranks: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for 20% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for 30 sec.

talents.name: Improved Vampiric Embrace
ranks: Increases the percentage healed by your Vampiric Embrace by an additional 5%.

talents.name: Darkness
ranks: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

talents.name: Shadowform
ranks: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
